reuse.why: Extends the shared schedules module with one isHoliday predicate used by isNonWorkingDay and the two daily-schedule sites, though those sites could have used isNonWorkingDay itself (weekend || holiday) instead of recomposing it.

duplication.why: The MM-DD rule exists once in isHoliday; the two server sites still repeat the weekend-or-holiday composition that isNonWorkingDay already expresses, carried over from before.

placement.why: The holiday matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend-skip logic that already owns it.

scope.why: Only the holiday predicate, its three uses and one test changed.

maintainability.why: One definition of what a holiday entry matches; small leftover duplication of the non-working-day composition in app.ts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks, including getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the daily-schedule filters in server/schedules/app.ts, go through isHoliday.

disguised_duplication.where: The two daily filters in getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange keep a pre-existing inline weekend-or-holiday expression, but the holiday rule itself is shared, not copied.
